text:
I am stone in suffering pain, wax in tender love; wise in loving noble pain, foolish in persisting in my harm.


Fearful of not defeating my cowardice, brave in not being defeated by myself; human feeling hurt, beast not awakening disabused.


Among red fires, amid your harsh cold disdain, I am a salamander fulfilling your whims;


and my pupils, with your eyes absent, became nymphs dwelling within two rivers.

translation.title: Don Francisco de Quevedo
